entry.title: Welcome to Robbs' Blog
entry.content:
Welcome to the English edition of Robbs’ Blog.

This site mirrors the Chinese blog at robbs.win, recording notes and practices on Linux, DevOps, architecture, PHP, Ruby, and frontend development.

己所不欲，勿施于人 — Do not impose on others what you yourself do not desire.

Topics

  • Linux & Operations — everyday commands, Nginx, Shell, Ubuntu
  • DevOps — deployment strategies, microservices, process managers
  • Architecture — container design, operations standardization
  • Development — PHP, Ruby on Rails, JavaScript

English translations are being added gradually. Thank you for visiting.
